# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Theology student and minister  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c19 P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an extremely unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame, long legs, flaxen and limp unkempt hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and large ears. Despite his plain looks, he has a scholar's forehead, impassioned dark eyes when preaching, a broad smile, and a delightful voice.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He has a deep, tender, and noble nature. He is intensely earnest and spiritual regarding his calling, with a great capacity for love, though he can be shy and hesitant to express his feelings due to a lack of wealth.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P27](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0027)_

## Traits

- Unattractive  <sub>[v1 c25 P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Earnest  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>
- Spiritual  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>
- Hesitant due to poverty  <sub>[v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020)</sub>

## Abilities

- Preaching with eloquence and passion  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To fulfill his calling as a minister and contribute his portion of sincere labor to the world  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Ezra Hale studied theology at St. Columbia and graduated from Wexcombe College. During the summer, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he stayed at a select boardinghouse and became close friends with Cressida Lindsay. After much hesitation over his lack of fortune, he eventually proposed to Cressida, and they were married in June before settling in a mission church on Tanner Street.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P10](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0010), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020), [v3 c29 P5](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0005)_

> I attempted to be a different person for a extended period—I lacked the desire to be a clergyman. However, I eventually realized that it was the labor assigned to me—and with the assistance of God, I will endeavor to fulfill it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
